subject: Exec hiring slate + comp band sign-offs (Q2)
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood-inference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood-inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exec hiring slate + comp band sign-offs (Q2)

Team —

I'm circulating the proposed executive hiring slate and the compensation bands for Q2 so we can lock headcount and proceed with offers where ready. High level: we have budget for 3 new Exec-level hires this quarter (VP / Head / Director-level with exec comp packages). I need sign-off on bands and two things: (1) approval to extend offers within band, (2) path for any above-band exceptions.

Proposed hires (priority order):
- VP Product (open; target: Amy Reynolds, currently in final interview loop)
  - Base: $240k - $290k
  - Target OTE (base + bonus): $270k - $330k
  - Equity: 0.5% - 0.9%
- Head of Reliability (Director -> Head)
  - Base: $200k - $250k
  - OTE: $220k - $275k
  - Equity: 0.25% - 0.5%
- Head of Talent (internal backfill or external)
  - Base: $185k - $220k
  - OTE: $200k - $240k
  - Equity: 0.15% - 0.35%

Attached: comp_bands_q2_2026.xlsx; exec_offer_template_v3.pdf.

Ask: please reply with either (A) explicit sign-off on the bands and permission to extend offers within those ranges, or (B) redlines to the bands. If an above-band offer is necessary, note justification and intended approvals.

Target timeline: extend VP Product offer by end of week if we have sign-off.

Thanks —
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
VP Engineering, Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood-inference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec hiring slate + comp band sign-offs (Q2)

Evelyn —

Thanks for the clear breakdown. A few immediate notes from finance:

- Bands look reasonable overall but the top of the VP Product base at $290k is higher than our mid-case model for Q2 headcount spend. If we go to the high end we should expect adjustments elsewhere.
- Equity percentages at the top end (0.9%) are OK for strategic execs but please provide the candidate justification for >0.7% (level, scope, relocation, market comp).
- We have a one-time Q2 hiring premium of $200k for critical roles; beyond that we need to pull from Q3. I want to avoid more than one above-band exception this quarter.

Can you also confirm whether the VP Product candidate is requesting sign-on or relocation assistance? If yes, include the proposed amounts in the offer packet.

Markus
Markus Klein
CFO, Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec hiring slate + comp band sign-offs (Q2)

Evelyn / Markus —

I reviewed the bands and the proposed slate. From Talent's side I approve the bands with two edits:

1) Move VP Product equity top to 0.8% (from 0.9%) to preserve reserve for negotiation across multiple critical hires.
2) Head of Reliability base band: tighten lower bound to $210k to reflect market for distributed systems leaders.

Operational asks:
- Any above-band offer requires written justification and CEO sign-off (per our exec hiring policy). I'll route approvals once I have the justification memo.
- We have a limited number of equity-heavy offers remaining in the executive pool; please flag if you want to consume more than one slot.

Attached: approval_matrix_q2.pdf (matrix for above-band approvals and sign-off flow).

If there's agreement on the two edits above, I authorize Talent to prepare the VP Product offer and hand it to Aditya for outreach. Also confirm once Markus approves the narrow change to Head of Reliability so I can finalize comps.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Talent, Redwood Inference
